funfacts.text: The street outside my apartment is one-way
I sometimes see a bird on my way to work
There are 14 steps between my floor and the ground floor
The elevator in my building makes a beep sound on every floor
The nearest bus stop is 230 meters from my door
My refrigerator hums in the key of F
There are three power outlets in my living room
The tap in my kitchen drips once every 47 seconds
My first name has two syllables
